question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **floating**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's take a look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• **Floating **means being buoyed up on water or other liquid.
 
• **Stacking **means arranging things in an ordered pile.
 
• **Sinking **means going down below the surface or to the bottom of a liquid or soft substance like water.
 
• **Soaring **means rising high in the air while flying without moving the wings or using power.
 
 
 
• As per the given meaning of the words "floating" is the most appropriate option to fill the blank.
 
• The implied meaning of the given sentence is that "**The Titanic was alerted to floating icebergs throughout the day on April 14, 1912.**"

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete passage: *On 14th April 1912, the Titanic received warnings all the day about **(1) floating**__ icebergs. The first message was received at 9 a.m. Similar messages (2)______. Around 9 p.m., Captain Smith (3)______ with his second officer, before retiring for the night. They knew that on such a clear, moonless night it would be (4)______ difficult to spot icebergs. Why did they not change the course of the ship and take the ice-free southern route? It remains one of the (5)______ mysteries surrounding the Titanic.*
